posts.post: The moment you understand that your wardrobe is a communication tool, you stop buying brands that hide who you are. Average men wear labels to gain status. Exceptional men wear intention to gain respect. Be the latter.

Fun fact: Your comfort zone is a high-interest loan. It feels good now. It destroys your future capacity. The only way to win is to intentionally seek the things that make you feel like an amateur again. Stay uncomfortable.
